title: Zucchini Frittata
subtitle: with feta and fresh herbs
description: A zucchini frittata made light by gently whipping the egg whites. Cooked in a pan with feta, sage and parsley.

steps.text: Separate the eggs. Lightly whip the egg whites to a soft foam.
Heat the olive oil in a pan and fry the finely chopped onion and garlic. Add the sliced zucchini.
In a bowl, mix the egg yolks, cream, flour, chopped sage, chopped parsley and grated cheese (keep a little cheese aside). At the last moment fold in the whipped whites gently, then pour into the pan.
Cook over low heat with the pan covered for about 5 minutes. Sprinkle a little more cheese on top.
Either put the pan in the oven or keep cooking on the stove for another 2 minutes, or until the frittata is set. Season with salt and pepper.
